name: Alphonso Atelier
description: A broad asymmetric mango-cheek portrait sits inside concentric member-colour arcs, above an offset title and a spacious letter.

name: Cheek to Cheek
description: Two opposing fruit-cheek portraits flank a slim vertical name spine; the title stretches beneath them and opens into the writing.

name: The Scored Heart
description: An open typographic page with a nine-square mango score, a squared title field and a quiet inset writing panel.

name: Peel Poetry
description: A narrow curling peel winds through the margin of a tall letter, with a small vertical name tab and an expansive italic title.

name: Mangifera Nocturne
description: A slender side portrait, an oversized monogram-like fruit curve and staggered ruled text create an intimate evening folio.

name: Pulp Signal
description: A smooth asymmetric smartphone with a curved top corner, tiny contact portrait and side-aligned incoming bubbles.

name: Lassi Link
description: A compact square-screen messenger with a ribbed speaker, recessed display and rounded hardware keys.

name: Cheek Chat
description: A wide folding touch device places paired portraits beside the conversation, joined by a vertical hinge.

name: SliceOS
description: A tall lock-screen handset frames an enormous clock, mango-slice notifications and a slim gesture bar.

name: Manila Mail
description: A slim slider handset with a broad portrait header, separate message screen and a scored nine-key deck.

name: Stonelet
description: A compact seed-shaped corner and coloured binding hold a tiny open note.

name: Petiole
description: A petite side portrait hangs from a curved stem beside a short reply.

name: Golden Cube
description: A small squared card with a scored corner, stacked title and inset member-colour rule.

name: Blush Bite
description: A low paired-image strip sits beneath a tiny reply, with opposed mango-cheek curves.

name: Last Sliver
description: A slender diagonal peel edge holds a minimal note with a sideways name tab.
